title: Studio S5 path to approval: the search on seeded SYNTHETIC plans
disclaimer: Educational planning tool. Not financial, legal or lending advice. Lenders make their own decisions.
scope: Seeded SYNTHETIC plans (src/uwcopilot/studio/path_to_approval/synthetic_plans.py) searched on the SYNTHETIC metro and on each real metro in its current mode. The path-found rate depends on how the plans are generated and on the editable targets and lever bounds; it describes the search on these plans, not any real founder's chances.

targets: P(year-2 DSCR >= 1.00 after the lender's 20% revenue stress (NSP-4.2)) at least 0.80

target_sources.dscr_min: NSP-4.1 of the SYNTHETIC startup program = corpus/guidelines/northwind_business_credit.md NBC-4.2, term loan minimum decision DSCR (SYNTHETIC document of a fictional institution; also the NSP-4.1 threshold of the SYNTHETIC startup program)
target_sources.stress_revenue_share: NSP-4.2 of the SYNTHETIC startup program (corpus/programs/northwind_startup_program.md), which applies the NBC-4.5 revenue stress of the SYNTHETIC Northwind guideline; constants imported from agent/policy_credit.py
target_sources.stressed_dscr_min: NSP-4.2 of the SYNTHETIC startup program (corpus/programs/northwind_startup_program.md), which applies the NBC-4.5 revenue stress of the SYNTHETIC Northwind guideline; constants imported from agent/policy_credit.py
target_sources.p_dscr_min: design choice of the build plan (docs/studio/founder_studio_build_prompts.md Prompt S5 and the lead engineer's decision of 2026-10-13); editable; not a lender rule
target_sources.p_stressed_min: design choice of the build plan (docs/studio/founder_studio_build_prompts.md Prompt S5 and the lead engineer's decision of 2026-10-13); editable; not a lender rule
target_sources.p_cash_negative_max: design choice of the build plan (docs/studio/founder_studio_build_prompts.md Prompt S5 and the lead engineer's decision of 2026-10-13); editable; not a lender rule
target_sources.cash_months: the S3 simulator's cash check (P(cash < 0 within 24 months)); design choice of the build plan (docs/studio/founder_studio_build_prompts.md Prompt S5 and the lead engineer's decision of 2026-10-13); editable; not a lender rule

plan_generator.status: design choices of the project author (generator parameters, not data)

definitions.path_found_rate: share of plans that do not meet the three targets as they are for which the search returns at least one change-set of one or two levers inside the default bounds that meets all three
definitions.path_found_and_program_compliant_rate: the same, counting only plans where at least one returned change-set also leaves the plan meeting every startup-program rule the search checks (NSP-3.1 equity injection, NSP-8.1 loan amount and term)
definitions.levers_changed: number of levers in a returned change-set (1 or 2)
definitions.runtime: wall time of one find_paths() call in a warm process, in ms (search.runtime_ms), called with the metro's data fabric as the website calls it
definitions.band: band of the plan's drawn one-forecast stressed year-2 DSCR (synthetic_plans.TARGET_BANDS)
definitions.anchored_by: how the plan was anchored to its drawn target: demand, rent_quote or none (not anchored)

structural_margin_check.method: sum of the profile's cost ratios (low, mode, high); margin before labor and rent = 1 - sum at the modes; the stress can pass at the modes only when that margin exceeds the stress share (necessary, not sufficient: labor, rent and debt service still have to be covered)

runtime.call_path: find_paths(..., fabric=<the metro's data fabric>) for every run, the call the website makes (web/services/studio_runs.py); the fabric's mode is computed once per fabric object (search.mode_of)

quick_vs_full.note: quick mode searches a subset of full mode's grid on the same paths and seed, so for single-lever change-sets quick can only return the same or a larger change; a smaller one can only come from the pair heuristic

stress_target_effect.question: If the search used only P(DSCR >= 1.25) and P(cash < 0) (the original Prompt S5 targets), how often would the change-set it shows miss the simulated stress target (P(stressed DSCR >= 1.00) >= 0.80, a design choice), and how often would it fail the lender's single base-case NSP-4.2 check (year-2 median stressed DSCR >= 1.00)?

s3_resimulation.method: each returned change-set's applied plan is run through feasibility.simulate() with the same seed and number of paths; the three probabilities must equal the search's (common random numbers)

facts_moved.method: every field of every applied plan (ids, the site's demand, the facts, every Plan and Loan field) is compared with the founder's plan; a field that moved is counted unless this script's own table (EXPECTED_WRITES, not guardrails.py) lets one of the change-set's levers write it. The headline plans carry no founder facts (as in the S3 worlds), so this part cannot catch hidden debt or an edited verified figure; facts_variant below does

facts_variant.method: each plan again with SYNTHETIC founder facts (synthetic_plans.with_synthetic_facts: credit score, experience, a seller note in about half of the plans, each typed figure verified with probability 0.25), searched in quick mode as the website does; every returned change-set and closest result is checked as above (facts unchanged, no verified figure moved, nothing outside its levers). The S3 re-simulation check is not run on these plans because S3's simulate() has no other debt

heuristic_vs_brute_force.method: quick mode's settings for both (grid, 1,000 paths, seed; the heuristic also has quick mode's budget); the brute force tries every single value and every pair of values of the available levers with the same guardrails, program checks and random draws (path_to_approval/exhaustive.py); every business type on the SYNTHETIC metro and car_wash, laundromat on every real metro
